_comment: THE POOL — every sentence a resume may print. Copy to jarvis/resume-pool.json. Each bullet's text must appear VERBATIM in cv.md (the build refuses otherwise). Org keys and bullet keys are yours to name; jarvis/resume-variants.mjs and jarvis/resume-plan.mjs refer to them, so rename there too. `titles` gives one title per resume family (total-experience, automation, manufacturing, mechanical).
name: Alex Rivera

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering

fixture.text: Designed a fixture in SolidWorks for an assembly step, with tolerance analysis, drawings and a bill of materials.

time-study.text: Ran time studies on a production line and documented the change that reduced cycle time.

robotic-arm.text: Designed and built a 4-DOF arm with servo actuation and a 3D-printed gripper.
